about:
The postcommunio of the formulary “Septuagesima Sunday” in the 1962 Roman Missal.

The proper page prints the prayer body with the short cue Per Dominum. The complete ending and Amen follow the common formula. They are not printed in full beside this prayer.

s01.translation: May Your faithful, O God, be strengthened by Your gifts, that they may both seek those same gifts by receiving them, and receive them without end by seeking them. Through our Lord Jesus Christ, Your Son, who lives and reigns with You in the unity of the Holy Spirit, God, forever and ever.
